newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen extending correction.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen extending correction.

text.p: Argentine stocks were expected to open lower Monday, following through on the downturn suffered late last week, dealers said.

"It looks like we're headed for some difficult days, with weakness on the U.S. markets after Friday's jobs report and caution spreading on the bolsa linked to company results and to the alliance forged by opposition parties," said Leonardo Torres Barsanti at analysts Rio Research.
He was referring to a deal struck over the weekend by the Radical and Frepaso parties to run together in October midterm polls and also to close ranks for the 1999 presidential vote.
